erasureRequests.label: Take customers' requests to erase their details
erasureRequests.help: Off by default. When on, the team can file a customer's request to erase his personal details, and only the owner carries it out, with a typed confirmation. His name, numbers, e-mail and addresses are removed from his profile and his orders; money and stock records stay. It cannot be undone.

requestsListSize.label: Erasure requests listed
requestsListSize.help: How many of the latest erasure requests the Privacy & data page lists.
